All features verified working correctly: 1) DGC prefix for walk-in/emergency bookings, 2) DGO prefix for web bookings, 3) Booking ID format PREFIX-DDMMYY-XXXX, 4) Doctor images display correctly on BookingConfirmation page.

appointment_routes.py (line 121-132): Legacy wrapper correctly routes to new generator with service detection

context_for_next_testing_agent: Booking ID format testing complete. New format is PREFIX-DDMMYY-XXXX where PREFIX is DGO (DiaGyn Online), DGC (DiaGyn Clinic walk-in/emergency), MGO (Mango Labs Online), ORO (Orange Pharmacy Online). Doctor images on BookingConfirmation are correctly mapped via getDocImg() function.
